mekanism:mod_version_loaded.why: It only gates I Like Wood compat recipes, and that mod is not part of this port.

notes: Survival items are priced at their crafting recipe, or at the item cost of the machine recipe when that is the way to make them. Energy stored on an item is not part of the cost: transmutation does not copy that data.

Osmium ingots cost one and a half iron ingots. The osmium rail recipe yields twenty-four rails from six ingots, and a cheaper osmium ingot would make vanilla rails cheaper to transmute than to craft. Osmium nuggets are excluded because 384 does not divide by nine.
Uranium ingots follow ProjectE's uranium ingot tag (4096). Raw uranium matches the ingot, and uranium nuggets are excluded because 4096 does not divide by nine.
Tin and lead ores and raw ores are fixed at Item Alchemy's tag values. Tin and lead nuggets then settle slightly under the raw ore; the ingot is not fixed, so that split does not fight a tag.

Sawdust is fixed at 64 because three sawdust craft six paper. The sawmill's plank and log recipes turn vanilla logs into more planks than crafting does; both ends of that recipe are vanilla, so it is not a conversion.

Sulfur dust matches gunpowder, because injecting gunpowder and enriching the dust are one-to-one. Coal gasification also makes sulfur from coal, which is worth less than gunpowder; that recipe is not a conversion, or sulfur could not match gunpowder.
Ore factories that double raw ore or silk-touched ore are not conversions. Crystals, shards, clumps and dirty dust are worth one dust, and one dust is one ingot.

Hydrogen, oxygen, chlorine, brine, lithium, sodium, superheated sodium, steam, ethene, heavy water, nutritional paste and hydrogen chloride are made from water. A bucket of each costs an empty bucket. Sulfur dioxide, sulfur trioxide, sulfuric acid, hydrofluoric acid, uranium oxide and uranium hexafluoride are priced from the items that produce them.

One substrate and ethene make eight substrate. That reaction is not a conversion, or substrate would be worth a fraction of itself. Substrate is priced at two bio fuel, which crushing plants produces.

The fission reactor is not in this port. Polonium and plutonium pellets are priced at the fluorite dust their reactions consume. One antimatter pellet is a thousand polonium pellets, which is how many millibuckets of polonium the SPS spends.

Lithium dust, salt and salt blocks are evaporated from water and are excluded. Induction cells and providers are priced without that dust. ProjectE 1.1.0 does not value an elytra; the HDPE elytra uses Item Alchemy's elytra value (16463) on Forge so the craft resolves there too.

mekanism:ingot_osmium.why: Six osmium ingots craft twenty-four rails. Vanilla rails cost six iron for sixteen, so an osmium ingot must be worth one and a half ProjectE iron ingots (384) or the rail recipe devalues rails.

mekanism:raw_osmium.why: One raw osmium smelts into one osmium ingot.

mekanism:raw_uranium.why: ProjectE values the uranium ingot tag at 4096, and one raw uranium smelts into one ingot.

mekanism:fluorite_gem.why: Fluorite ore drops a Fortune-boosted handful of gems, about as common as nether quartz; only the gems are valued.

mekanism:tin_ore.why: Item Alchemy's c:tin_ores tag values tin ore at 192, so the stone ore matches that tag.

mekanism:deepslate_tin_ore.why: Item Alchemy's c:tin_ores tag values deepslate tin ore at 192.

mekanism:lead_ore.why: Item Alchemy's c:lead_ores tag values lead ore at 256.

mekanism:deepslate_lead_ore.why: Item Alchemy's c:lead_ores tag values deepslate lead ore at 256.

mekanism:raw_tin.why: Item Alchemy's c:raw_tin_ores tag values raw tin at 192, and one raw tin smelts into one ingot.

mekanism:raw_lead.why: Item Alchemy's c:raw_lead_ores tag values raw lead at 256, and one raw lead smelts into one ingot.

mekanism:sawdust.why: Three sawdust craft six paper. Paper is 32, so sawdust is 64 or that recipe would devalue paper. The sawmill only returns sawdust as a chance byproduct.

mekanism:dust_sulfur.why: Injecting one gunpowder yields one sulfur dust, and enriching that dust yields one gunpowder, so the dust is worth the gunpowder.

exclude.mekanism:creative_bin: Creative-only bin. It has no survival recipe, and a value would only make a creative container transmutable.
exclude.mekanism:creative_fluid_tank: Creative-only fluid tank. It has no survival recipe.
exclude.mekanism:creative_energy_cube: Creative-only energy cube. It has no survival recipe.
exclude.mekanism:creative_chemical_tank: Creative-only chemical tank. It has no survival recipe.
exclude.mekanism:bounding_block: A multiblock places this structural block. It has no recipe and drops nothing.
exclude.mekanism:osmium_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw osmium. Only the raw ore is valued, as ProjectE does for ores.
exclude.mekanism:deepslate_osmium_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw osmium. Only the raw ore is valued.
exclude.mekanism:uranium_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw uranium. Only the raw ore is valued.
exclude.mekanism:deepslate_uranium_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw uranium. Only the raw ore is valued.
exclude.mekanism:fluorite_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of fluorite gems. Only the gems are valued.
exclude.mekanism:deepslate_fluorite_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of fluorite gems. Only the gems are valued.
exclude.mekanism:nugget_uranium: ProjectE fixes a uranium ingot at 4096, which nine nuggets cannot split evenly. Any nugget value lets one of the two crafting recipes gain EMC.
exclude.mekanism:nugget_osmium: An osmium ingot is fixed at 384 so osmium rails do not devalue vanilla rails, and nine nuggets cannot split 384 evenly.
exclude.mekanism:salt: A thermal evaporation plant makes brine from water, and crystallizing that brine makes salt. Water has no EMC, so salt does not either.
exclude.mekanism:block_salt: Nine salt pack into a block, and salt is evaporated from water, which has no EMC.
exclude.mekanism:dust_lithium: Lithium dust is crystallized from lithium, which a thermal evaporation plant makes from brine, which is water. Water has no EMC, so the dust does not either.

conversions.name: hydrogen_chloride_bucket
conversions.why: One salt becomes 2 mB of hydrogen chloride. Salt is evaporated from water, which has no EMC, so a bucket costs the empty bucket.

conversions.name: hydrofluoric_acid_bucket
conversions.why: Dissolving one fluorite gem yields 1,000 mB of hydrofluoric acid, so a bucket is one gem and the bucket. The millibucket of sulfuric acid is a catalyst.

conversions.name: uranium_hexafluoride_bucket
conversions.why: One millibucket of hydrofluoric acid and one of uranium oxide make two of uranium hexafluoride, so two buckets cost one of each input bucket.

conversions.name: dirty_netherite_scrap_from_scrap
conversions.why: Enriching one dirty netherite scrap yields one scrap. The crusher's three-scrap debris recipe is the fortune-style bonus and is not the conversion.

conversions.name: ore_chain_dirty_from_dust
conversions.why: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

conversions.name: ore_chain_clump_from_dirty
conversions.why: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

conversions.name: ore_chain_shard_from_clump
conversions.why: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

conversions.name: ore_chain_crystal_from_shard
conversions.why: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

conversions.name: pellet_antimatter_from_polonium
conversions.why: Crystallizing 1,000 mB of antimatter yields one pellet. The SPS makes each millibucket from 1,000 mB of polonium, and the polonium pellet reaction is the item recipe that consumes 1,000 mB of polonium, so one antimatter pellet costs a thousand polonium pellets. This port has no fission-reactor block, so the fuel that produces the gas is not an extra item cost.

conversions.name: sulfur_dioxide_bucket
conversions.why: Oxidizing one sulfur dust yields 100 mB of sulfur dioxide, so a bucket is ten dust and the bucket.

conversions.name: sulfuric_acid_bucket
conversions.why: One sulfur dust converts into 2 mB of sulfuric acid, so a bucket is five hundred dust and the bucket.

conversions.name: sulfur_trioxide_bucket
conversions.why: Two sulfur dioxide and one oxygen make two sulfur trioxide, so a bucket of trioxide costs the dioxide in a bucket.

conversions.name: uranium_oxide_bucket
conversions.why: Oxidizing one yellow cake yields 250 mB of uranium oxide, so a bucket is four yellow cake and the bucket.

conversions.why: Four basic circuits and one basic energy cube. The four lithium dust are crystallized from water, which has no EMC, so they add nothing.

minecraft:elytra.why: ProjectE 1.1.0 does not value an elytra. Item Alchemy does, at 16463, and the HDPE elytra is crafted from one, so ProjectE uses the same figure.
